jcr:content.jcr:title: How soon can infants travel after birth?

master.answer:
• Up to 48 hours after birth – too young to travel.
  • Three to seven days after birth – travel can be requested by completing our medical clearance form.
  • Eight days or more – infants older born prematurely or with complications should complete our medical clearance form. Healthy infants may travel without medical clearance.

If you require medical clearance for your infant, download the form and once it’s been completed by your treating doctor, you can request clearance to travel via our online medical request form. Ensure you attach the completed Medical Clearance Form and allow at least 48 hours to receive clearance to travel.
